name: appmixer.resend.core.SendEmail
label: Send Email
description: Send an email through the Resend Email API.
author: Appmixer <info@appmixer.com>

from.title: From
from.description: Sender email address. To include a friendly name, use the format 'Your Name <sender@domain.com>'.

to.title: To
to.description: Recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings. Max 50.

bcc.title: BCC
bcc.description: BCC recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings.

cc.title: CC
cc.description: CC recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings.

scheduled_at.title: Schedule At
scheduled_at.description: Schedule email to be sent later. The date should be in natural language (e.g.: 'in 1 min') or ISO 8601 format.

reply_to.title: Reply To
reply_to.description: Reply-to email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings.

html.title: HTML Body
html.description: The HTML version of the message.

text.title: Text Body
text.description: The plain text version of the message.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Custom headers to add to the email.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Filename and content of attachments (max 40MB per email, after Base64 encoding of the attachments).

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Custom data passed in key/value pairs.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Add an idempotency key to prevent duplicated emails. Should be unique per API request.
